newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Treasury cancels Wednesday news conference.
newsitem.headline: Italian Treasury cancels Wednesday news conference.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said on Wednesday it had called off a joint news conference by Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi, Finance Minister Vincenzo Visco and Regional Affairs Minister Franco Bassanini.
The news conference had been called to explain the impact of reforms to the Italian budget, tax and administrative systems.

Newspapers reported that Prime Minister Romano Prodi would offer to resign in an address to parliament later on Wednesday in return for support from the centre-right on the deployment of a security force for Albania. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782505
